gaps.MX-VIS-036--light: Kit self-contradiction: SubdeckList.jsx renders crumbs + FilterRow + list, the shot draws a DECKS section and no filter chips. Owner rulings 2026-07-25 (JSX is the source of truth) and 2026-07-26 (the shot will not be regenerated) make this a permanent recorded gap, not a parked one. The app follows the JSX; this entry exists so the ratchet still blocks every other regression.
gaps.MX-VIS-037--light: Same kit self-contradiction, loading branch: the shot is a skeleton of chrome the JSX never renders. Permanent per the 2026-07-26 ruling.
gaps.MX-VIS-069--light: Measured: 7.67% light / 9.45% dark (8.35 / 10.43 before the create FAB landed). Every section of the kit composition is built and correct; the residual is four things that cannot be built here. (1) The strip carries 2 of the kit's 4 stats — minutes-studied has no producer at all (`int-9`) and words-learned-today is recorded only when a daily goal exists (`int-12`); the two missing cells shorten the strip by one row and shift everything below it up, which is most of the diff. (2) The app bar's notification bell needs a notifications feature and (3) its avatar an account, both WBS 14.x. Recorded rather than parked: the number is real and the causes are enumerated, so the ratchet blocks any regression while the row stays honest about why it is not green.
gaps.MX-VIS-078--light: Measured: 18.82% light / 18.72% dark, down from 21.49 / 21.42 once the confirm took the kit's icon `Dialog` composite (int-54). What is left is not the dialog: the kit's shot stages this over Stage 5 - Fill at 21/25 on the card 'school', while the fixture is a five-card session on its first card, and the study shell's app bar is the divergence int-5 already owns (the kit draws an X and an overflow; this build draws a back arrow and none). Closing it means seeding the shot's own session and finishing int-5, neither of which belongs to the dialog.
